annotations.title: Text to speech (TTS): natural voices, audio file

description: Turn up to 300 characters of text into natural, human-sounding speech: MP3 in English (40 voices) or Spanish (10 voices) with Deepgram Aura-2, or WAV in French, Chinese, Japanese or Korean with MeloTTS (one voice each). Pick a voice by name or leave the default. Use for voice replies, audio notes, accessibility and phone or chat bots; for up to 2,000 characters use text_to_speech. Example: text=Your payment was received. Thank you!. Price $0.01/call via x402 USDC or a card key (/credits); failed calls free. Reads or computes only and changes nothing; each call is charged, so repeats are not free.

format.description: Audio format: mp3 (default), wav, pcm (raw 16-bit little-endian mono), ulaw or alaw (8 kHz telephony, e.g. Twilio), opus (Ogg) or flac. opus and flac only for text spoken in one part (up to 450 characters)

lang.description: Language: en or es (Aura-2 MP3, many voices); fr, zh, ja and ko are retired (MeloTTS was removed from Workers AI, 20 Nov 2026); default en

pronunciations.description: How to say words: JSON {"Nginx":"engine x","GIF":"jif"} or Nginx=engine x, GIF=jif (up to 50, whole words, any case)

sample_rate.description: Sample rate in Hz for wav and pcm (8000, 16000, 24000 default, 32000, 48000) or ulaw/alaw (8000 default, 16000)

text.description: Text to speak, up to 300 characters

voice.description: Voice name. English: amalthea, andromeda, apollo, arcas, aries, asteria, athena, atlas, aurora, callista, cora, cordelia, delia, draco, electra, harmonia, helena, hera, hermes, hyperion, iris, janus, juno, jupiter, luna, mars, minerva, neptune, odysseus, ophelia, orion, orpheus, pandora, phoebe, pluto, saturn, thalia, theia, vesta, zeus. Spanish: sirio, nestor, carina, celeste, alvaro, diana, aquila, selena, estrella, javier. Default: luna (en), aquila (es)
